meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: Claude 会读取当前 GitHub 仓库里所有打开的 Issue 和 PR,逐条分析并生成调查报告,保存到 /tmp 下的时间戳文件夹。报告中的每个结论都会附上代码链接作为证据。它不会在 GitHub 上做任何改动,只输出报告。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”“triage issues”“triage PRs” 等关键词,或要求进行 GitHub triage 时触发。

say.note: 扫描所有打开的 issue 和 PR 并生成报告

howto.what_en: Claude fetches all open issues and PRs in the repo, analyzes each one in a background task, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{timestamp}/. Every claim includes a GitHub permalink. It never comments, merges, closes, or edits anything on GitHub—reports only.
howto.when_en: Triggers on the words 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'.

say_en.note: Runs full triage on all open issues and PRs.
